result.brief: 提出运动固体驱动的交互式4D体积液体预测任务与TIDE/TIDES两级循环框架，通过局部界面建模、输运耦合与稳定化实现长时程稠密速度场预测。
result.reason: Motion-conditioned dense 3D liquid velocity forecasting with recurrent rollout; a physical dynamics world-modeling contribution, though not a video/multimodal foundation model or representation-learning paper.
